item.title: Official entry info for Honduras was updated (Nov 5, 2026)
item.description: UK government note: "Updated information about visa requirements, including British citizens now being able to visit Honduras for up to 90 days without a visa ('Entry requirements' page)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
